messages:
rachel: Heads-up: scheduling an UNPIN of model redwood-llama3x-q4b from canary cluster at 2024-05-10T16:00:00Z. Need QA + ops signoff.

Tom: Why unpin? I thought this model had better perf on embeddings.

rachel: It does for embeddings, but runtime v4.0 introduced a kernel tweak that regresses chat throughput on short prompts. We pinned model to runtime v3.9 in canary last week. The plan is to unpin so canary uses runtime v4.0 variant.

ops-lee: Observability note: last two canary runs showed 5% increase in small-request tail latency; also saw a couple of grpc stream resets. Requesting a 10-minute staged ramp (10/30/60/100%).

qa-maya: QA: we need smoke tests for prompt-truncation edgecases and embedding drift checks. I'll queue a canary-eval run and add a regression alert.

rachel: deploy-bot please schedule unpin with staged ramp and attach telemetry slice for first 20k requests. Abort if p95 > 150ms or embed-cosine-delta > 0.02.

deploy-bot: automated: schedule_unpin accepted -> target=model=redwood-llama3x-q4b env=canary when=2024-05-10T16:00:00Z ramp=[10,30,60,100] ramp_interval=300s telemetry_slice=canary-llama3x-20240510-01 abort_conditions=[p95>150ms,embed_cosine_delta>0.02,grpc_reset_rate>0.5%].

Tom: SDK compatibility: platform-sdks v3.0 includes the new header shims; older clients (<=2.9) may drop requests due to payload header mismatch. Add a CI gate: block full ramp if >0.5% of recent requests used sdk<=2.9.

qa-maya: Added tests and a quick script to sample user-agents and SDK versions. Will post results into the telemetry slice in 15m.

ops-lee: Also note: fallback routing rule ready -> stable-model-route -> model=redwood-llama3x-q4b@v3.9. We should tag 10% of canary traffic as prefer-stable so we can exercise fallback.

rachel: Good. Rollback policy: immediate rollback to v3.9 if any of: p95 delta > +40ms vs Baseline, grpc_reset_rate > 0.5%, or memory OOM on host. Rollback token stored with rollback-bot.

rollback-bot: ready: rollback-token=rb-20240510-llama3x stored; will execute automated rollback if invoked.

Tom: One more: release notes need a short entry about model-runtime binding change and the SDK caveat. I'll draft and link.

rachel: thanks. Also schedule a 30m cooldown after full ramp before we mark canary as "unpin-complete".

deploy-bot: update: telemetry slice created -> slice_id=canary-llama3x-20240510-01. Staged ramp schedule set. Will emit a 5m pre-start notice.

qa-maya: sampling SDK matrix now: current sample shows 0.3% clients <=2.9. Under the 0.5% gate. Posting logs: https://internal.ci/llama3x/samples/20240510

ops-lee: Noted. I'll watch GPU host memory and grpc resets. If any host reports OOM the system will cordon and rollback.

rachel: final checklist: 1) staged ramp 10/30/60/100 2) telemetry slice + embed drift check 3) SDK gate <=0.5% old clients 4) fallback route for prefer-stable 5) rollback token present 6) 30m cooldown. If all good, proceeding at 16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: 5m notice -> starting ramp at 2024-05-10T16:00:00Z; will post progress updates and abort if any abort condition triggers.

Tom: LGTM. If we get noise, prefer scoped canary (10%) and iterate kernel patch.

qa-maya: I'll run the embed regression harness during ramp and post a summary at +20m.

rachel: thanks team. Closing thread; will reopen if rollback or unexpected signals appear. :metal:
